items.title: Home Cinema Streaming Platform
items.summary: Full-stack streaming platform with HLS playback, authentication, subscription gating, and Vimeo integration.
items.description: Sri Lankan subscription streaming platform built at CeylonX. React + TypeScript web client, a Node.js / Express API, and a separate React admin panel for catalog, payment, and subscription management. Video is delivered over HLS (m3u8) with Vimeo as the origin to scale to many concurrent viewers, Stripe handles recurring subscriptions, and Firebase Cloud Messaging powers push notifications. Deployed to AWS with GitHub-triggered CI/CD.

items.title: Gaming Platform
items.summary: Micro-service gaming platform with an API gateway, account and lobby services, deployed on Kubernetes for concurrent players.
items.description: Web-based gaming platform built at D B International Technology. An API gateway fronts separate account and lobby services that communicate over RabbitMQ, deployed on Kubernetes for concurrent players. Worked on auth proxying through the gateway, lobby routing across games / vendors / categories, and edge rate-limiting. NestJS services backed by PostgreSQL.

items.title: NestJS Microservice Architecture
items.summary: Self-initiated streaming-platform backbone — API gateway fronting independent Auth and User services with hardened security and full observability.
items.description: Self-initiated streaming-platform backbone. API gateway fronts independent Auth and User services over RabbitMQ with idempotency keys and domain-event fan-out. Per-service circuit breakers, exponential-backoff retries, and Redis caching keep the gateway resilient. Auth is hardened with RS256 JWT, Argon2id password hashing, device fingerprinting with session-family token-reuse detection, per-endpoint rate limiting, and account lockout. Observability via Prometheus metrics and Jaeger distributed tracing.

items.title: Restaurant POS System
items.summary: Production POS running at Iluk Restaurant & Bar and Savour Street — order entry, menu management, and staff workflows.
items.description: Production restaurant POS system running at Iluk Restaurant & Bar and Savour Street. Worked across the React frontend, the admin dashboard, and the Node.js backend APIs covering order entry, menu management, and authentication. Maintained features for live restaurant operations on top of the existing stack.

items.title: HLS Video Player
items.summary: Custom HLS player with M3U8 streaming and a NestJS video conversion backend.
items.description: Custom HLS video player built in Next.js supporting M3U8 streams with adaptive bitrate playback and quality selection. Paired with a NestJS backend service that handles video uploads and converts them into HLS format for streaming.

items.title: Influencer Management System
items.summary: Web application for managing influencer campaigns, profiles, and collaboration workflows.
items.description: Management platform for tracking influencer profiles, campaign workflows, and collaboration pipelines. Frontend built with a modern React stack. Backend to be published separately.

items.title: Three.js Interactive Globe
items.summary: Three.js 3D globe built for the CeylonX corporate marketing site, with animated sections and a TinyMCE-powered admin.
items.description: Built for the CeylonX corporate website and admin portal. The React marketing site features a Three.js 3D globe and animated sections, backed by a Node.js / Express and MongoDB API covering blog, portfolio, careers, testimonials, and project requests. A TinyMCE admin lets non-technical editors manage all content themselves.

items.title: Chicken Road Crash Game
items.summary: Real-time multiplier crash game — bet, then cash out before the live multiplier crashes. Cocos Creator client + NestJS backend.
items.description: Real-time multiplier crash game where players bet and cash out before a live multiplier crashes. The Cocos Creator client uses a Finite State Machine architecture and calls backend endpoints via the built-in Fetch API for bet creation, crash-point checks, cash-outs, and auth. The NestJS backend broadcasts round state over Socket.IO with RabbitMQ for event fan-out, backed by PostgreSQL.

items.title: Treasure Hunt Crash Game
items.summary: Treasure-themed crash game with animated gameplay and server-side state.
items.description: Treasure-themed crash game with animated gameplay and server-side game state management. Session lifecycle, animations, and payout logic kept authoritative on the NestJS service.

items.title: Lottery Scratch Game
items.summary: Digital scratch ticket game — Cocos Creator client and a NestJS ticket-generation engine that produced ~130M tickets into PostgreSQL.
items.description: Digital Scratch Card ticket game built across backend and game client. The ticket-generation engine validates against a weight table to produce exact winning and losing distributions that protect RTP, regenerating on validation failure and returning tickets to the player instantly. Extended into a batch pipeline that generated ~130M tickets into PostgreSQL. NestJS + TypeORM service, Cocos Creator client.

items.title: Omi Card Game
items.summary: Sri Lankan trick-taking card game with a Next.js frontend and a Rust backend.
items.description: Digital version of Omi, a 4-player team-based trick-taking card game. Next.js frontend with real-time game UI, paired with a Rust backend on SpacetimeDB handling deck management, trump selection, trick resolution, scoring, and AI bot opponents. First team to 10 points wins.
